faq.a: Jameelah is associated with the Arabic form جميلة, whose core sense is beautiful, comely (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Jameelah?
faq.a: Jameelah is associated with Arabic. Jameelah is Arabic جَمِيلَة (Jamīla) 'beautiful, comely' (feminine), from the root ج م ل (j-m-l). The source gloss 'Beautiful' is consistent. Same name as jameela, jamilaa, jamilah and jamillah.
Yes — the underlying form جميلة is Arabic.
Jameelah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Jameelah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Jameelah is rendered جمیلہ and carries the sense جمیلہ، خوبصورت.

faq.q: What does Jameelah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Jameelah is rendered جمیله and carries the sense جمیله، زیبا.
A romanized syllable approximation is ja-mee-lah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Jameelah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Jameelah, jameelah. Script forms are جميلة, جمیله, جمیلہ, जमीला.

faq.q: Is Jameelah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
